title: Illumina DNA Prep Part 4: Clean Up Libraries
author: Opentrons
materials: Slot 2's plate can be disposed of

steps.title: Centrifuge sample plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample plate at 280 × g for 1 minute to collect contents at the bottom of the wells.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to magnetic plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 70 µL from each well of the sample plate to the available wells (columns 7‑12) of the deep‑well plate on the magnetic module in slot 2.

steps.title: Engage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module at a 10 mm height and incubate for 5 minutes to allow beads to clear.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to second plate
steps.instruction: Move 45 µL of the cleared supernatant from columns 7‑12 to the corresponding wells in columns 1‑6 of the deep‑well plate located in slot 3.

steps.title: Add nuclease‑free water
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL of nuclease‑free water (NFW) to each well in columns 1‑6 of the slot 3 plate.

steps.title: Add IPB mix and bead‑mix
steps.instruction: Add 45 µL of IPB mix to each well in columns 1‑6 of the slot 3 plate, then perform bead mixing 10 cycles using 100 µL volume: aspirate from the bottom, dispense 3 mm above, aspirate at that higher position, and dispense back to the bottom; repeat for a total of 10 cycles (mix the IPB tubes every other aspiration).

steps.title: Incubate diluted samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate in slot 3 for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Dispose of slot 2 plate
steps.instruction: Discard the plate that was in slot 2.

steps.title: Dispose of slot 4 magnetic plate
steps.instruction: Discard the deep‑well plate that was on the magnetic module in slot 4.

steps.title: Move slot 3 plate to magnetic module
steps.instruction: Transfer the plate from slot 3 onto the magnetic module in slot 4 in preparation for Part 5.
